## 2. Continue merge through completion
- Start from the newest working Codex integration state (including RC2 #258 and any subsequent confirmed progress), NOT historical main. Preserve an immutable rollback baseline. Use a dedicated integration branch/worktree; don't overwrite active Codex changes.

Provide clear reproducible user playtest steps. If blocked by an external dependency, preserve the best merged candidate and identify the exact unavoidable gate instead of claiming 100%.

**Definition of done:** One working Windows x64 application with ALL latest compatible functionality previously developed by Codex and a validated inventory proving that no Codex-developed package was silently omitted. Continue until complete or a concrete unresolvable external blocker is evidenced.
